description: Decompose frontend/src/lib/useConvexData.ts behind characterization tests. Closes TD-217. The file has accumulated hook boilerplate across multiple query types (projects, sprints, tasks, agents, settings) and exceeds the 500-line god-file threshold. Goal: split into per-resource hooks (useProjects, useSprints, useTasks, useAgents, useSettings) backed by a small shared useConvexQuery core.
